description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DecryptionTrait' used for handling decryption operations in the AWS SDK, including methods for decrypting ciphertext streams, building cipher methods, and extracting tags from streams.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of ciphertext using provided materials, envelope metadata, and cipher options, returning a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from a ciphertext stream based on the tag length.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Removes the authentication tag from the ciphertext stream, returning only the encrypted data.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates a stream that decrypts data on-the-fly, handling different cipher modes such as GCM.
